units: <cite ref="Pesachim 76a:15">Pes. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>סגי ליה בק׳</he> it is sufficiently remedied by paring the surface.
<cite ref="Pesachim 76a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ מיהא ניבעי</he> let it at least be pared; a. e.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95b:5">Snh. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>שריון ק׳</he> (= <he>ש׳ קשקשים</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 17:5">I Sam. XVII, 5</cite>) a scaly coat of mail.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:2">Nidd. III, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:2">Tosef. ib. IV, 2</cite> <he>המפלת מין ק׳</he> an abortion that has the appearance of a mass of membranes. Ohol. VI, 5, sq. <he>כקְלִיפַת השום</he> as thin as the husk of garlic.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 76a:17">Ab. Zar. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שתשיר קְלִיפָתָן</he> until the crusty accretion of the vessels falls off (by exposure to heat); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bekhorot 58a:15">Bekh. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … כק׳ השום וכ׳</he> all Jewish scholars appear to me (as paltry) as the husk of garlic, except &c.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite> <he>קליפת בצלים</he>, v. <cite ref="S01403"><he>קְלַף</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>קְלִיפוֹת</he>, <he>קְלִיפִים</he>, <he>קְלִיפין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 4:3">Tosef. Nidd. IV, 3</cite> <he>כמין קליפין אדומין</he> (masc.); <he>כמין קליפות אדומות</he> the appearance of red membranes.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <he>מה אגוז … שתי ק׳ וכ׳</he> as the nut has two shells &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 9:5">Sabb. IX, 5</cite> <he>קְלִיפֵי רמונים</he> shells of pomegranates.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 5:3:2">Y. Ter. V, end, 43ᵈ</cite> <he>קילפי איסור</he> (read: <he>קליפי</he>) shells of forbidden fruits.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00695"><he>קֶטֶב</he></cite>; a. e.—

Pes. 112ᵇ (in Chald. dict.) מאן דמדרך אקליפים (some ed. אקְלִיפַיָּא; Ms. M. אקליפי דבצים) he that treads on egg-shells.—[In later mystic literature קליפה, pronounced קְלִיפָּה, a certain class of demons, cmp. Num. R. l. c.]
